tools.description: Search available motorcycle transport routes in France. Filter by departure city, arrival city, and date range. Returns paginated results with dates, prices, available slots, a next_cursor for the following page, and for each trip a booking_url that opens its booking page on symone.fr (the stops sea

tools.name: cities_near
tools.description: Find SYMONE-served cities near a given location. Pass a city or region name to get nearby cities where SYMONE operates motorcycle transport.

tools.name: get_booking_url
tools.description: Get the link the user must open to book a scheduled SYMONE trip or to request a quote for another route or date, plus reservation contacts. With route_id (from search_routes) the trip details are repeated next to the link. With need "quote" and the trip details, the link opens the quote form already

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request (demande de devis) to SYMONE for the customer, for any route and date, including routes not listed by search_routes. Nothing is recorded until the customer confirms: SYMONE e-mails them a link (valid 48 h) to check the request, accept the terms and confirm. The quote then arrive

tools.name: get_quote_request
tools.description: Status of a quote request sent with request_quote: pending_confirmation (waiting for the customer to click the e-mail link), confirmed (recorded; the quote comes by e-mail), expired, cancelled_by_customer, superseded or failed.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Prepare the booking of a scheduled trip from search_routes (UCP checkout). SYMONE computes the price; payment never goes through the assistant: the response has status requires_escalation and a continue_url. Give that link to the customer, who checks the booking on symone.fr and pays on the secure P

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Current state of a checkout session: requires_escalation (the customer still has to open continue_url and pay), completed (paid; order id given), incomplete (trip no longer bookable: choose another) or canceled (expired after 24 h, canceled, or turned into a quote request). The price is recomputed a

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Replace the content of an unpaid checkout session (other trip, number of motorcycles, riders, buyer). Send the whole checkout again, as for create_checkout.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: UCP complete step. SYMONE never takes payment through an assistant, so this never charges anything: it returns the session with status completed if the customer has already paid on symone.fr, otherwise requires_escalation with the continue_url to give to the customer.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel an unpaid checkout session (nothing was charged and no seat was held). A paid booking cannot be canceled here: the customer contacts SYMONE under the terms of sale.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_url · Private data: get_booking_url, cancel_checkout · Public sink: get_booking_url, request_quote, update_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking_url · Private data: get_booking_url, cancel_checkout · Public sink: get_booking_url, request_quote, update_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_routes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
